itemsRequired.howToGet: Make it: use chocolate dust on a bucket of milk, then snape grass on the chocolatey milk (the ingredients below).

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Culinaromancer's Chest in Lumbridge Castle basement for 6 gp.
itemsRequired.note: Bucket of milk (Obtained by using a bucket on a dairy cow, one is north of Ardougne, or bought from Hudo or Heckel Funch.)

itemsRequired.howToGet: Free spawn: East Ardougne - Edmond and Alrena's house (members only).
itemsRequired.note: Picture of Elena (Inside Alrena and Edmond's house)

route.title: Starting the quest
steps: Speak to Edmond. Dialogue: "What's happened to her?", "Yes."
Speak to Alrena inside or near the house.
Take the Picture of Elena off the table in the house.
Speak to Edmond.
Use 4 buckets of water on the mud patch behind the house (between the cabbages and potatoes).
Dig with a spade on the softened ground.
Go south to the farthest pipe.
Attempt to open the grill.
Use a rope on the grill.
Speak to Edmond.
Put on the gas mask and climb up the pipe.

route.title: Finding Elena
steps: Go east and speak to Jethick; he will give you a book. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll return it for you."
Go north to the house against the wall (next to the rotten apple spawn).
Attempt to open the door.
Speak to Martha Rehnison or Ted Rehnison in the house.
Go upstairs and speak to Milli Rehnison.
Go south of the town square to the large building along the southern wall with an "X" on the doors and a staircase inside going down. Attempt to open the door. Dialogue: "I fear not a mere plague."

route.title: Getting inside
steps: Go to the large main building on the north side of the town square, north of the manhole.
Talk to the Clerk in the main room. Dialogue: "Who is through that door?", "This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!"
Speak to Bravek. Dialogue: "This is really important though!", "Do you know what's in the cure?"
:He will give you a scruffy note for a hangover cure.
Use the hangover cure on Bravek; he will give you a warrant. Dialogue: "They won't listen to me!"

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Return to the Mourner house, the one with "X" on the doors and the stairwell.
Search the barrel west of the staircase for a small key.
Go downstairs, enter the cell, and speak to Elena.
Return to the town square, go down the manhole, through the sewer, climb the mud pile, and speak to Edmond at his house.
Congratulations, quest complete!
